column1: # Columns (whitespace-separated): id  layer  catalog_id  theorem  lean_file  entry
#   id          D1 | R1 | T1 | C1 — exactly these four, one each.
#   layer       model | atom | close — only moves UP. Descending a row
#               so that atom|close count falls below floor_promoted = red.
#   theorem     atom/close: must exist as `theorem <name>` in lean_file,
#               statement carries a forall-binder, file has zero `sorry`.
#   lean_file   path or `-` on model rows.
#   entry       the rustc-linked kernel fn the row is about.
# floor_promoted N pins the minimum number of atom|close rows. Freeze
